Subject: SIG / CAIQ - selective log handback & destruction certificate request

Hi Jordan,

We are finalizing Novagen's procurement checklist and have a couple of SIG/CAIQ follow-ups around data lifecycle for our tenant (novagen-prod-01). Can Redwood provide the following artifacts/clarifications by COB 2027-06-22 so our procurement team can complete the control mapping?

1) A signed Data Destruction Certificate template (we can DocuSign) that covers a tenant-scoped deletion of ephemeral debug/session logs.
2) A 90-day export (sample or full) of ephemeral debug logs for novagen-prod-01; if full export is not allowed we need a redacted sample of 5-10 representative rows plus a description of redaction rules.
3) A short mapping (1-2 paragraphs) of Redwood retention and TTL controls relevant to CAIQ/SIG (which tables/logs are ephemeral vs persisted).

We marked this high priority on our side since it's gating our security attestation. If you need to loop in your security team or legal, please do — Tom (cc) and our pci-ops alias will review.

Thanks,
Elisa Gomez
Head of IT Compliance
Novagen Therapeutics

Thanks Jordan — this is feasible. Outline below with responsible owners and estimated dates. We should be able to deliver everything Novagen needs within their requested window.

Deliverables & plan:

1) Redacted sample (5 rows) of ephemeral debug logs
   - Owner: Marissa / Support Ops
   - What: a redacted CSV with timestamps, non-identifying event codes, and sanitized message text; PII removed using our redact pipeline.
   - Delivery: 2027-06-16 EOD (secure S3 link or encrypted attachment)

2) Full 90-day export — conditional
   - Owner: Support Ops / Infra exports team
   - Notes: We can produce a tenant-scoped export: s3 export path will be staged to a secure bucket with restricted ACLs. If the export contains customer PII we will apply our redaction transform and provide a redaction manifest describing what was removed.
   - Delivery: confirm availability by 2027-06-18; if approved, ship by 2027-06-19 via secure transfer.

3) Data Destruction Certificate (draft + signature)
   - Owner: Security (Kimberly) + Legal (Rishi for signature if Legal required)
   - Template: attached (data-destruction-certificate-template.pdf) — please review for any contractual language Novagen requires.
   - DocuSign link (draft): https://docusign.com/envelope/example-5892
   - Target signed date: 2027-06-20

4) CAIQ / SIG mapping paragraph
   - Owner: Security (Kimberly) with a short blurb we can paste into their control response
   - Delivery: 2027-06-16 along with the sample

Operational notes and controls to call out:
- TTLs: ephemeral debug logs are retained for 30 days by default; session shards and tracing aggregates are retained 90 days depending on the tenant config. We will include an explicit mapping doc for the Novagen tenant.
- Redaction: our pipeline removes full names, emails, and account identifiers by default; we will surface the redaction manifest for review.
- Audit trail: deletion events are logged in our secure audit trail and we can provide a signed audit extract showing the deletion action when the destruction certificate is issued.

Blockers / questions:
- Does Novagen require legal countersignature on the destruction certificate, or is Security signature sufficient?
- Do they accept the DocuSign flow above or do they prefer a different signing vendor?

If no blockers I will: (a) draft the CAIQ paragraph and destruction certificate language, (b) confirm export staging path with Infra, and (c) send the redacted sample on 6/16.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
Security & Compliance

Attachments referenced: data-destruction-certificate-template.pdf (draft), internal export manifest to follow
